Additional Figures

12

Figure 3: Comparison of test accuracy for Kuramoto-FedAvg, FedAvg, and SCAFFOLD over several
training iterations on three benchmark datasets, evaluated at different heterogeneity levels. KuramotoFedAvg consistently achieves higher accuracy faster than FedAvg and SCAFFOLD. The rapid
accuracy improvement highlights the practical benefits of reducing gradient misalignment through
synchronization, demonstrating how Kuramoto-FedAvg effectively addresses model complexity and
dataset-specific optimization challenges across varying degrees of client data skewness.
